notes: I changed the rule: the box strips only **leading** spaces (not trailing) before appending "ny". E4 shows `" a"→"any"` and `" hello"→"hellony"` (leading stripped) but `"a "→"a ny"` and `"hello "→"hello ny"` (trailing preserved), and all-space inputs collapse to `"ny"`. Tabs are left untouched (`"a\tb"→"a\tbny"`), so I strip only spaces, not general whitespace.
